ORDINANCE

BEIT
ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 18-D in the area bounded by

East 72" Street;
South Dorchester Avenue;
the alley next south of and parallel to East 72" Street;

a line 198.61 feet east of and parallel to South Dorchester Avenue;8

to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 7200 South Dorchester Avenue Chicago, IL 60619
